subject: Kickoff: Evaluation charter & prompt ownership for Aceta POC
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Olson <sara.olson@acetahealth.com>, Aceta POC Team <poc@acetahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Evaluation charter & prompt ownership for Aceta POC

Hi Sara + Aceta team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the POC. This thread will serve as the initial MAP kickoff so we can align on success criteria, benchmark plan, owners for prompt/evals, and the close cadence. Attached is a draft MAP (Aceta_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short POC success criteria doc. Please consider this a starting point; we want a tight 6-week evaluation and a clear decision path at the end.

High-level goals I heard from our call:
- Validate extractive clinical accuracy on patient notes (entities + relations)
- Meet latency and cost targets for embedded inference in your ingest pipeline
- Show safe/controlled hallucination rates below your threshold for clinical review

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Extraction F1 >= 0.85 on the blinded testset (owner: Aceta evaluation lead)
- P95 latency <= 300ms for 512-token generation on the dedicated instance profile
- Regression delta vs baseline embeddings < 2% on cosine-sim metric for retrieval tasks
- No PII leakage incidents in the curated prompt set > threshold (owner: Neha)

Ownership (suggested):
- Laura Bennett (Redwood) — MAP lead, weekly cadence, escalation
- Priyom Das (Redwood) — Eval harness, benchmark plan, and metric dashboard
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Security/compliance checks, prompt red-team oversight
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Integration engineer for data pipeline and runbook
- Sara Olson (Aceta) — Clinical SME & evaluation sponsor; identify blinded testset owner

Immediate asks:
1) Sara: confirm who will be the Aceta testset owner and primary reviewer for clinical accuracy.
2) Aceta: share any non-disclosure or data-access constraints we should include in the MAP (e.g., sample size, de-identification).
3) Internal owners: please review the attached MAP and add comments by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize the timeline.

Next steps:
- We’ll run a 30-minute alignment session Tuesday to lock the bench (metrics + datasets). I’ll send calendar invite after we receive your availability.

Attachments: Aceta_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP outline), POC_success_criteria_v1.docx, benchmark-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121
https://redwood.ai
From: Sara Olson <sara.olson@acetahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aceta POC Team <poc@acetahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evaluation charter & prompt ownership for Aceta POC

Laura — thanks for pulling this together and for the draft MAP. Quick answers from our side: 
- Testset owner: I’m looping in Dr. Miguel Alvarez (cc’d on our internal thread — he’ll start assembling the de-identified notes). For now, point-of-contact is poc@acetahealth.com.
- Data constraints: we need the notes to be de-identified to HIPAA Safe Harbor standards. We’ll provide a 1,000-note blinded set for the primary bench and a 200-note holdout.
- Timeline: the 6-week window works but we’d prefer a soft decision checkpoint at week 4 to determine whether to expand to a 2nd site.

We’ll review the attachments and confirm by EOD Tuesday. I’m available for the Tuesday slot after 11:00 PT.

Best,
Sara Olson
Head of Clinical Ops — Aceta Health
sara.olson@acetahealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Olson <sara.olson@acetahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Evaluation charter & prompt ownership for Aceta POC

Thanks Laura / Sara — I reviewed the MAP and attached a focused benchmark plan (benchmark-plan.xlsx) that maps tests to owners and expected metrics. A few clarifications and asks: 

- Bench breakdown:
  * Extraction bench (owner: Aceta lab) — scoring script: we’ll provide an open-source scorer; Priyom will own integration into our dashboard.
  * Retrieval/embedding bench (owner: Redwood) — will run locally against your holdout set; metric: cosine mean + recall@10.
  * Safety prompts red-team (owner: Neha) — we’ll run a 200-sample adversarial prompt set and surface fail cases.

- Data handoff: please upload the blinded set to the secure share link we provided in the MAP (Redwood S3 with presigned link). We will not persist raw notes beyond the evaluation unless you opt-in in the MAP.

- Run cadence: propose weekly results drops (Fridays) and a mid-point checkpoint at week 3 for technical gating. That gives Aceta a decision runway at week 4 as requested.

I’ve updated the MAP with the owners column and timeline; see Aceta_MAP_v1.xlsx. If that looks good I’ll create the dashboard and invite the relevant viewers.

— Priyom
